raw_response: BNY Mellon described its ETF servicing business as experiencing "particular strength" and validated multiyear investments into these platforms. Specifically, for the period ending in Q4 2024, ETF Assets Under Custody and Administration (AUCA) reached $2.8 trillion, representing an increase of over 60% year-over-year, with inflows into ETFs on BNY's platform outpacing the market.
